title: GREAT SCOTT! A wild n00b appears!

posts.author: TheAnimationVoice
posts.body:
Hello hello! I'm TheAnimationVoice, voice over talent, indie game streamer/vtuber (twitch; same screenname as on here), and general goofball. I've been gaming since the NES days, with SNES/16 bit era being my favorite era of gaming. Square during the 90s was the BEST.
I recently picked up rpg maker 2003 on steam (it was on sale for $2) and have been learning it/working with it for about 2 weeks. Been enjoying it and making steady progress so far. Glad to be here!
